raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

This PR lets a plugin add a speculative decoding method to vLLM without a fork. A package registers the method from a `vllm.general_plugins` entry point, users select it by name in `--speculative-config`, and Model Runner V2 builds its speculator. On hybrid models, a registered method can also verify drafts that are not a chain (a tree, for example) in the GDN and Mamba2 layers, through a data-only `LinearAttnVerifyExtension`. **With no method registered, no new code path runs.**

```python
from vllm.v1.spec_decode.registry import SpeculativeMethodSpec, register_speculative_method

def register():  # a vllm.general_plugins entry point
    register_speculative_method(
        "my_method", SpeculativeMethodSpec(speculator_cls="my_pkg.spec:MySpeculator")
    )
```

```bash
vllm serve <target> --speculative-config '{"method": "my_method", "model": "<draft>", "method_config": {"depth": 4}}'
```

A method vLLM does not ship needs a fork today, because `SpeculativeConfig.method` is a closed `Literal`, `SpeculativeConfig` forbids extra fields, and Model Runner V2 picks the speculator in a closed if/elif chain. On hybrid models the GDN and Mamba2 layers verify speculative rows as a chain, so a tree method cannot verify there either.

This PR applies to `main` on its own. #62963 builds on it and adds the Model Runner V2 calls that a non-chain verifier also needs (a custom rejection sampler, verify-input and accepted-path hooks).

## Claims

- `register_speculative_method(name, SpeculativeMethodSpec)` makes `method=<name>` valid. Other unknown names are still rejected, and the error lists the registered ones. `method_config` is passed to the method uninterpreted and is part of `compute_hash()`. The spec's `configure` hook runs at the end of `__post_init__`, and its traits (target hidden states, auxiliary hidden states, lookahead slots) feed the places that key on the method name today.
- `init_speculator` builds the registered speculator. Registered methods select Model Runner V2, as watermarking does, and `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0` with one raises a clear error.
- The autoregressive drafter combines auxiliary hidden states for any method whose draft model has `combine_hidden_states`, in addition to `eagle3`.
- GDN and Mamba2 layers hand their spec-decode rows to a `LinearAttnVerifyExtension` as typed zero-copy views (projections, states, gate parameters, indices, accepted counts and the output buffer). The extension replaces only the in-tree spec kernels, and the prefill and plain decode rows of mixed batches keep the in-tree path.
- `SharedExperts.disable_aux_stream()` lets a caller opt one MoE layer out of the auxiliary-stream fork and join before graph capture. It is a separate `[MoE]` commit and can move to its own PR if reviewers prefer.

Each extension point has a caller in an out-of-tree tree speculator. Its entry point registers the method, its `configure` reads `method_config` to set `num_speculative_tokens`, `num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size` and the draft model config, and Model Runner V2 builds its `BaseSpeculator` subclass at start-up. Its EAGLE-3-style draft head reads the target's intermediate-layer hidden states as `eagle3` does. Its tree verifier runs the conv and the recurrence over the tree rows through the extension, on Qwen3.5-architecture GDN targets and on Nemotron-H-style Mamba2 hybrids, and stores each row's state for #62963's `post_accept` to commit. `disable_aux_stream()` serves speculators that capture conditional verify graphs on MoE targets with shared experts, because a conditional graph body cannot join an auxiliary stream captured outside it.

## Validation

AI assistance (Claude) was used to prepare this change; I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests listed below.

The CPU row ran on this base. The GPU rows were measured on the previous upstream base, with this PR on top of #62961 and under #62963, and re-measurement on this base follows.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| CPU tests, the touched files plus the attention, KV-cache and worker files they depend on, one pytest process per file | 525 passed against 490 on `main`, no new failures |
| GPU tests on B300, same files | 697 passed. The one failure, `test_kv_cache_planning.py::test_is_kv_cache_spec_uniform`, is a 60 s subprocess-import timeout that fails the same way on `main`. |
| Qwen3.8-27B at TP4 with MTP, 33 prompts, an out-of-tree method registered, `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` | Greedy outputs identical to the same build without this PR and #62963 (33 of 33), no sync errors |

The CPU failures are the same 15 on both trees, 7 in `test_gpu_model_runner.py` and 8 CPU-builder cases in `test_group_head_counts.py`. The registry tests check name validation, `configure`, traits, the hash, the registration rules and lazy class import, and that `init_speculator` builds the registered class while built-in methods stay unchanged. The extension tests check that the GDN and Mamba2 builders attach the extension and keep it through `update_block_table`, that the layers pass the spec rows as zero-copy views (in mixed batches too) and run the in-tree kernels without an extension, and that ReplaySSM is refused with one. The shared-experts test covers the CPU contract and a CUDA conditional-graph replay of both branches. All five new files pass on CPU and on GPU, and `pre-commit` (mypy included) passes on this range.

```bash
pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu python -m pytest -q tests/v1/spec_decode/test_method_registry.py tests/v1/spec_decode/test_method_registry_runner.py tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_verify_extension.py tests/v1/attention/test_mamba2_verify_extension.py tests/model_executor/layers/test_shared_experts_stream.py
```

## Not a duplicate

I ran the duplicate-work searches from `AGENTS.md` §1 (open PRs, with keywords for a speculative method registry or plugin, out-of-tree speculators on Model Runner V2, tree verification on GDN and Mamba2, and the shared-experts aux stream). No open PR adds a plugin registry for speculative methods or a linear-attention verify extension. These are related, and this PR uses no code from them:

- #42910 (DDTree) adds a tree method in-tree on the V1 runner. This PR serves methods that live outside vLLM, and the two are independent.
- #60339 (suffix decoding on MRV2) and #55947 (Uno) add built-in MRV2 speculators, which keep their own selection branch.

## Details

- Registered methods run only on Model Runner V2. The V1 `custom_class` path replaces only a proposer and cannot express non-chain verification.
- The extension gets data, not the layer object. The state layout is the in-tree one (row `i` at `spec_state_indices_tensor[b, i]`, resuming from `num_accepted_tokens - 1`). An extension without Mamba2 support raises at the first Mamba2 forward instead of verifying chains, and ReplaySSM is refused with an extension because it keeps no per-row states.
- `_forward_core` copies `b` and `a` after the extension branch, and the fused-norm entry passes them in uncopied, so the extension reads the projections as strided views. #62961 moves the same copy for the other entry. The two PRs merge without conflicts, and whichever lands second drops the resulting second pair of `.contiguous()` calls.
- The extension covers Qwen GDN and Mamba2 layers. Kimi and Olmo GDN layers, and prefix caching with a registered method, are outside this PR.
- Size: +542 / -27 non-test lines (+464 outside `vllm/config`), 943 test lines and 49 docs lines.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Extension point for verifying non-chain drafts on linear-attention layers.
+
+Gated delta net (GDN) and Mamba2 layers verify speculative tokens as a chain:
+row ``i`` of a request's query continues from row ``i - 1``, each row writes
+its own recurrent / convolution state to ``state_indices[req, i]``, and the
+next step resumes from row ``num_accepted_tokens - 1``. A draft *tree* needs
+row ``i`` to continue from another earlier row instead, which the in-tree
+kernels cannot express.
+
+A speculative method registered with ``register_speculative_method`` can set
+``SpeculativeMethodSpec.linear_attn_verify_extension`` to a factory for a
+``LinearAttnVerifyExtension``. Every ``GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder`` and
+``Mamba2AttentionMetadataBuilder`` then creates one and attaches it to the
+metadata it builds, and the layer hands the spec-decode rows of every forward
+to the extension (``forward_spec_rows`` for GDN, ``forward_mamba2_spec_rows``
+for Mamba2) instead of running its own convolution and recurrence on them.
+With no extension (the default) nothing changes.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import resolve_obj_by_qualname
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.registry import get_speculative_method
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GDNSpecRows:
+    """The spec-decode rows of one GDN layer's forward.
+
+    ``T`` is the number of spec-decode tokens and ``B`` the number of their
+    requests (a CUDA graph batch may pad ``B``; the in-tree kernels see the
+    same padding). Heads and dims are per tensor-parallel rank.
+    """
+
+    layer_name: str
+    """The layer's prefix, its key in the forward context."""
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, conv_dim]`` convolution input (the q, k and v columns). May be a
+    view whose row stride is larger than ``conv_dim``."""
+    a: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads]`` decay gate input. May be a strided view."""
+    b: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads]`` beta gate input. May be a strided view."""
+    conv_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, conv_dim, kernel_size - 1]`` convolution states."""
+    conv_weight: torch.Tensor
+    """``[conv_dim, kernel_size]``."""
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor | None
+    activation: str | None
+    ssm_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, num_v_heads, head_v_dim, head_k_dim]`` recurrent states."""
+    A_log: torch.Tensor
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor
+    num_k_heads: int
+    num_v_heads: int
+    head_k_dim: int
+    head_v_dim: int
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B, max_query_len]``: the state slot of each row of each request."""
+    num_accepted_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B]``: request ``b`` starts from ``state_indices[b, n - 1]``."""
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B + 1]``: the rows of each request in ``mixed_qkv``."""
+    out: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads, head_v_dim]``, written by the extension."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Mamba2SpecRows:
+    """The spec-decode rows of one Mamba2 layer's forward.
+
+    ``T`` is the number of spec-decode tokens and ``B`` the number of their
+    requests (a CUDA graph batch may pad ``B``; the in-tree kernels see the
+    same padding). Heads and groups are per tensor-parallel rank.
+    """
+
+    layer_name: str
+    """The layer's prefix, its key in the forward context."""
+    hidden_states_B_C: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, conv_dim]`` convolution input (the x, B and C columns). May be a
+    view whose row stride is larger than ``conv_dim``."""
+    dt: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_heads]`` time step before ``dt_bias`` and softplus. May be a
+    strided view."""
+    conv_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, conv_dim, kernel_size - 1 + num_spec]`` convolution
+    states."""
+    conv_weight: torch.Tensor
+    """``[conv_dim, kernel_size]``."""
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor | None
+    activation: str | None
+    ssm_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, num_heads, head_dim, ssm_state_size]`` SSM states."""
+    A: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]`` float32 (``-exp(A_log)``)."""
+    D: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]``."""
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]``; the in-tree kernels use ``softplus(dt + dt_bias)``."""
+    num_heads: int
+    head_dim: int
+    n_groups: int
+    ssm_state_size: int
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B, max_query_len]``: the state slot of each row of each request."""
+    num_accepted_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B]``: request ``b`` starts from ``state_indices[b, n - 1]``."""
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B + 1]``: the rows of each request in ``hidden_states_B_C``."""
+    out: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_heads * head_dim]`` SSM output (before the gated norm),
+    written by the extension."""
+
+
+class LinearAttnVerifyExtension:
+    """Runs the convolution and the recurrence of a GDN or Mamba2 layer's
+    spec-decode rows in place of the in-tree chain kernels.
+
+    State layout contract (the in-tree chain one): row ``i`` of request ``b``
+    stores its convolution and recurrent state at ``state_indices[b, i]``; the
+    initial state of request ``b`` is at ``state_indices[b,
+    num_accepted_tokens[b] - 1]``. A tree verifier keeps that layout and
+    computes row ``i`` from the row it continues; before the next step it moves
+    the accepted path's states into chain order.
+    """
+
+    def forward_spec_rows(self, rows: GDNSpecRows) -> None:
+        """Write the attention output of every spec-decode row to ``rows.out``
+        and every row's states as described above. Called for every forward
+        with spec-decode rows, including CUDA graph captures."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def forward_mamba2_spec_rows(self, rows: Mamba2SpecRows) -> None:
+        """As ``forward_spec_rows``, for a Mamba2 layer's decode rows."""
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"{type(self).__name__} does not verify Mamba2 layers; the "
+            "in-tree kernels would verify its drafts as chains"
+        )
+
+
+def create_linear_attn_verify_extension(
+    vllm_config: "VllmConfig",
+) -> LinearAttnVerifyExtension | None:
+    """The extension of the registered speculative method, if it has one."""
+    speculative_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if speculative_config is None:
+        return None
+    registered = get_speculative_method(speculative_config.method)
+    if registered is None or registered.linear_attn_verify_extension is None:
+        return None
+    factory = resolve_obj_by_qualname(
+        registered.linear_attn_verify_extension.replace(":", ".")
+    )
+    return factory(vllm_config)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Registry for out-of-tree speculative decoding methods.
+
+A package registers a method name once, usually from a ``vllm.general_plugins``
+entry point. ``SpeculativeConfig`` then accepts that name for ``method`` and
+Model Runner V2 builds the registered speculator instead of one of the built-in
+ones. Nothing is registered by default, so built-in methods are unaffected.
+
+Example::
+
+    def register():
+        register_speculative_method(
+            "my_method",
+            SpeculativeMethodSpec(speculator_cls="my_pkg.spec:MySpeculator"),
+        )
+
+The registered ``speculator_cls`` is a ``BaseSpeculator`` subclass (see
+``vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/speculator.py``) and receives
+``(vllm_config, device)``. Method specific options go in
+``SpeculativeConfig.method_config``, which vLLM does not interpret.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, get_args
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import resolve_obj_by_qualname
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config.speculative import SpeculativeConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SpeculativeMethodSpec:
+    """What vLLM needs to know about an out-of-tree speculative method."""
+
+    speculator_cls: str
+    """Lazy ``"package.module:Class"`` (or ``"package.module.Class"``) of the
+    ``BaseSpeculator`` subclass. Imported only when the method is used."""
+
+    configure: Callable[["SpeculativeConfig"], None] | None = None
+    """Called at the end of ``SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__``. It may fill
+    ``num_speculative_tokens``, ``num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size`` and
+    ``draft_model_config`` from ``method_config`` and the hardware."""
+
+    uses_target_hidden_states: bool = True
+    """The drafter reads the target's hidden states. This makes
+    ``SpeculativeConfig.use_eagle()`` true, which turns on the draft KV cache
+    group, the prefill lookahead and the connector handling that EAGLE-style
+    drafters need."""
+
+    uses_aux_hidden_states: bool = False
+    """The target must also return auxiliary (intermediate layer) hidden
+    states for the drafter."""
+
+    num_lookahead_tokens: Callable[["SpeculativeConfig"], int] | None = None
+    """KV slots to reserve past the scheduled query. ``None`` means
+    ``num_speculative_tokens``, the value EAGLE uses."""
+
+    linear_attn_verify_extension: str | None = None
+    """Lazy ``"package.module:factory"`` of a callable ``(vllm_config) ->
+    LinearAttnVerifyExtension`` (see
+    ``vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/verify_extension.py``). It lets the
+    method verify non-chain drafts on gated delta net and Mamba2 layers of
+    hybrid models."""
+
+    def resolve_speculator_cls(self) -> type:
+        return resolve_obj_by_qualname(self.speculator_cls.replace(":", "."))
+
+
+_REGISTRY: dict[str, SpeculativeMethodSpec] = {}
+
+
+def register_speculative_method(name: str, spec: SpeculativeMethodSpec) -> None:
+    """Register an out-of-tree speculative method under ``name``.
+
+    Raises ``ValueError`` if ``name`` is a built-in method, or is already
+    registered with a different spec (re-registering an equal spec is a no-op,
+    so a plugin entry point may run more than once in one process).
+    """
+    if not name or not isinstance(name, str):
+        raise ValueError("A speculative method name must be a non-empty string.")
+    from vllm.config.speculative import SpeculativeMethod  # it imports this module
+
+    if name in get_args(SpeculativeMethod):
+        raise ValueError(f"'{name}' is a built-in speculative method.")
+    existing = _REGISTRY.get(name)
+    if existing is not None and existing != spec:
+        raise ValueError(f"Speculative method '{name}' is already registered.")
+    _REGISTRY[name] = spec
+    logger.debug("Registered speculative method '%s' (%s)", name, spec.speculator_cls)
+
+
+def get_speculative_method(name: Any) -> SpeculativeMethodSpec | None:
+    """Return the spec registered under ``name``, or ``None``."""
+    if not isinstance(name, str):
+        return None
+    return _REGISTRY.get(name)
+
+
+def registered_speculative_methods() -> list[str]:
+    return sorted(_REGISTRY)
